answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the protocol anchors identity verification within a cryptographic forge where each new agent must execute irreversible stake burning. The network constructs a rigid jetty against spoofed peers by enforcing superlinear cost scaling: registering $k$ coordinated entities scales quadratically as $\mathcal{O}(k^2)$ burnt collateral. Any fraudulent collusion collapses into an economic karst of unrecoverable lost capital.
